Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-32, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 20 to Oct 31 and more rows (synopsis page 39, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
